@dusveloper @laiflonglearner totally agree with everything dustin shared here; i think it’s a combination of savings + risk tolerance + priorities

like in maslow’s hierarchy of needs - having enough for your basic expenses is the minimum (food, accommodation etc), you could then review additional expenses and calculate your runway based on that

everyone has different priorities (mortgage, kids, future plans) and leaving your job would likely mean delaying many of these bc of the uncertainty and instability

finally your individual risk tolerance matters - not everyone will be comfortable with or want to leave their job. doing what’s right for you is most important! 

hope this helps, and all the best nadia! 🫶🏻
